items.details: There is no dedicated hold-to-block button. Push the left stick toward the incoming attacker and press Square together; repeat the input for each hit in a sequence. An early input gives a defensive block, while a tighter timing window produces a counter when that attack permits one. Reorient toward attacks arriving from a different direction. Yellow-signaled grabs require evasion instead. Buy Defensive Offense and practice its Square + X input for a sidestep that complements parrying rather than replacing it.

details_i18n.pt: Não há um botão exclusivo para manter a defesa. Direcione o analógico esquerdo ao atacante e aperte Quadrado junto; repita o comando a cada golpe da sequência. Um comando antecipado bloqueia, enquanto um intervalo mais preciso produz um contra-ataque quando aquele golpe permite. Reoriente a defesa quando os ataques vierem de outra direção. Agarrões sinalizados em amarelo exigem evasão. Compre Defensive Offense e pratique Quadrado + X para executar um passo lateral que complementa a defesa, sem substituí-la.

items.details: Weaken an armored enemy until the game shows it can be cut, then hold L1 for Blade Mode. Align a deliberate cut through the highlighted extraction target rather than chopping every direction. When the Circle prompt appears, press it to take the enemy's repair unit and replenish life and Fuel Cell energy. Missing the marked target may still kill the enemy but loses this recovery opportunity. Leave Blade Mode when you have no useful cut to make so you do not waste the gauge.

items.details: Stay near enough to read the opening slash and parry each part of his combo instead of attacking through it. Punish a completed sequence with a short burst, then prepare to defend again. When he withdraws and sends reinforcements, finish those enemies and use Zandatsu to recover before the duel resumes. Keep your camera on his approach after each interruption. If you repeatedly lose the exchange, practice the direction-plus-Square input against his first attack rather than trying to win with a longer combo.

details_i18n.pt: Fique perto o bastante para reconhecer o primeiro golpe e defenda cada parte da sequência em vez de atacar através dela. Acompanhe sua aproximação com a câmera após cada interrupção. Se perder sempre a troca, pratique direção mais Quadrado contra o primeiro ataque em vez de tentar vencer com uma combinação longa.

During the scripted Blade Mode opportunities, cut the highlighted section of her weapon and follow the transition to the next arena. Repeat the same patient pattern on the pipe and final platform. For the no-damage trophy, use Hard or above and account for small-enemy hits as well as the boss herself.

items.details: Defend every hit of his fast strings; blocking the first does not automatically stop the rest. When his separated body evades attacks, an EM Grenade can stun him long enough to enter Blade Mode and strike the exposed head. Use the resulting opening rather than swinging into an invulnerable body. For thrown vehicles, either make the prompted cuts or use clear space to evade the barrage. Keep distance from the rolling mass of debris and follow the final traversal prompts when the arena changes.

items.details: Do not strike the red explosive plates indiscriminately. When a shield-cutting opportunity appears, align Blade Mode through the safe indicated gaps, then cut the exposed supports to remove the shield sections. Reposition if your angle would hit a plate. Deal with aerial support when it prevents a safe approach. Once the defenses are removed, keep reading his new attack pattern rather than assuming the fight is finished. A short punish after a defended combo is safer than a long attack into a renewed shield.

Resolva o apoio aéreo quando ele impedir a aproximação segura. Depois de remover as defesas, continue observando o novo padrão de ataques em vez de presumir que a luta acabou. items.details: Parry the ordinary axe strings and evade the attacks that cannot be blocked; do not start a long retaliation before the last swing.
